description.tr: Evrensel tarihi, modern öncesi en çok okunan İslam kronolojisi olma özelliğini korumaktadır || İbn Teymiyye'nin öğrencisi olarak hadis tenkidini tarih metodolojisiyle birleştirdi. || [Tarih notu] Gelenekçi kabul edilse de tarih eseri modern tarihçiliği önceleyen sofistike bir kaynak tenkidi gösterir.
description.en: His universal history remains the most widely read pre-modern Islamic chronicle; his tafsir became a standard reference for hadith-based exegesis || Student of Ibn Taymiyya, he combined rigorous hadith criticism with historical methodology. His Bidaya synthesized dozens of earlier chronicles while applying source-critical standards. || [Historiographical note] While often considered a traditionalist, his historical work shows sophisticated source criticism that anticipates modern historiography.
description.ar: يظل تاريخه الشامل أكثر التواريخ الإسلامية قراءةً قبل العصر الحديث || تلميذ ابن تيمية، جمع بين نقد الحديث والمنهجية التاريخية
